about.headline: Come Hungry. Leave Happy. Repeat Often.
about.short: Smoked meats, soul food classics and Friday seafood, cooked by Chef Darrell. There are no small portions, and every plate is guaranteed to please.
about.story: Food has always been more than a passion for Chef Darrell. It's a way to connect with people and create lasting memories. As the founder and heart behind Mr. Nice Guy, Chef Darrell's mission is simple: to bring exceptional culinary creations to life and leave a lasting impression on every customer's taste buds.
about.mission: At Mr. Nice Guy, our mission is to bring people together through food. We strive to create an environment where our customers can enjoy the perfect balance of familiar comfort and exciting new flavors.
about.vision: We aim to be a leader in flavor innovation, consistently introducing unique dishes and creating a lasting legacy in our community, with a fresh “spice of life.”
values: Transforming simple ingredients into extraordinary indulgences.
Bringing a sense of community through our food.
Always adapting to meet the changing tastes and preferences of our customers.
about.promise: From humble beginnings to becoming a favorite in our community, we've built a reputation for delicious food, welcoming service, and an ever-changing menu that keeps customers excited to return.
about.facebook_intro: Mr Nice Guy is located in the Woodstock area. We offer a variety of Southern Soul Food. There are no small portions and we guarantee 100% customer satisfaction.

days.title: Sack Lunch Wednesday
days.text: Quick, hearty combos: deluxe smash burgers, Philly cheesesteaks, loaded nachos and more.

days.title: Soul Food Thursday
days.text: Comfort food favorites: fried chicken, meatloaf, sweet potato soufflé and collard greens.

days.title: Seafood Friday
days.text: Shrimp po' boys, fried catfish, seafood mac n cheese and seafood Alfredo.

days.title: BBQ Saturday
days.text: Brisket, beef and pork ribs, chopped pork and smoked turkey legs with Southern sides.

catering.intro: Planning an event? Let Mr. Nice Guy handle the food! From intimate family reunions to large corporate gatherings, our catering is designed to impress your guests and leave everyone raving.

features.text: We take care of the setup, serving and cleanup, so you can enjoy the moment.

features.title: Versatile Options
features.text: Homestyle comfort food, upscale dishes or casual BBQ: we bring your vision to life.
